subheader: Talbrunn against a paper diary and an external billing bureau.
lead: The figures are for a practice we know well and are stated so you can check them against your own. Where our number is favourable we say what it excludes.
note: Basis: five practitioners, one address, about 1,100 treatments a month, prices as at July 2026. The comparison excludes the practice's own hardware, which it needs either way, and any change in fund contract rates.
cta_label: Get this worked out for your practice

figures.title: Talbrunn licence, 3 years
figures.text: €89 net a month for 36 months, at the standing price with no discount applied.

figures.title: Billing bureau, 3 years
figures.text: €300 a month, the median of the four bureaux our customers left between 2024 and 2026.

figures.title: Migration
figures.text: Charged in the first month. There is no matching figure on the other side; leaving paper costs nothing but time.

figures.title: Reception time returned
figures.text: Median across 34 changeovers: appointment calls, recall lists and invoice typing that stopped being manual.

figures.title: Unplanned downtime, 3 years
figures.text: Both under 40 minutes, both inside working hours, both published on our status page the same day.

figures.title: Recovered from missed recalls
figures.text: The lowest of the three practices that measured it. Two others reported more; we quote the lowest.
